ns2:course.label: Intro to U.S. Legal Practice
ns2:course.description: This required continuation of LAW 501 is designed to provide LL.M students with oral advocacy, legal writing and research skills. During the course of the semester, students will learn how to conduct fact investigation, negotiation, negotiate legal claims, conduct legal research and effectively advocate a legal position in writing. Focuses primarily on in-class exercise and meets once per week. No professional hours. 2 graduate hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: LAW 501.
